hist-exp-01-c1.text: Herodotus (trans. A. D. Godley) (1920). Histories, Book 4, section 42 (Perseus Digital Library, Tufts University, via Perseids). Perseus Digital Library / Perseids, Tufts University.
hist-exp-01-c1.quote: it was in the third that they rounded the pillars of Heracles and came to Egypt
hist-exp-01-c1.claim: According to Herodotus, around 600 BCE the Egyptian pharaoh Necho II commissioned a Phoenician fleet to circumnavigate Africa.

hist-exp-01-c1.text: Herodotus (trans. A. D. Godley) (1920). Histories, Book 4, section 42 (Perseus Digital Library, Tufts University, via Perseids). Perseus Digital Library / Perseids, Tufts University.
hist-exp-01-c1.quote: whenever autumn came they would put in and plant the land
hist-exp-01-c1.claim: the crews planting and harvesting crops along the way

hist-exp-02-c1.text: Mark Cartwright (2021). Vasco da Gama. World History Encyclopedia.
hist-exp-02-c1.quote: The treacherous Cape Bojador was navigated in 1434
hist-exp-02-c1.claim: Cape Bojador, long feared as the edge of the navigable world, was rounded in 1434.

hist-exp-02-c1.text: Mark Cartwright (2021). Vasco da Gama. World History Encyclopedia.
hist-exp-02-c1.quote: In 1488 Bartolomeu Dias sailed down the coast of West Africa and made the first voyage around the Cape of Good Hope
hist-exp-02-c1.claim: Bartolomeu Dias rounded the Cape of Good Hope in 1488, finally proving Africa could be circumnavigated.

hist-exp-02-c2.text: Joshua J. Mark (2020). Christopher Columbus. World History Encyclopedia.
hist-exp-02-c2.quote: Columbus' first voyage brought him to one of the islands of the Bahamas on 12 October 1492 CE
hist-exp-02-c2.claim: His three-ship expedition (Santa María, Pinta, Niña) made landfall in the Bahamas on 12 October 1492.

hist-exp-02-c3.text: Mark Cartwright (2021). Ferdinand Magellan. World History Encyclopedia.
hist-exp-02-c3.quote: Ferdinand Magellan, or Fernão de Magalhães (c. 1480-1521), was a Portuguese mariner whose expedition was the first to circumnavigate the globe in 1519-22 in the service of Spain.
hist-exp-02-c3.claim: The first circumnavigation of the globe was led by the Portuguese sailor Ferdinand Magellan, in service to Spain.

hist-exp-02-c3.text: Mark Cartwright (2021). Ferdinand Magellan. World History Encyclopedia.
hist-exp-02-c3.quote: It was here, on Cebu and the very brink of success, that Magellan was killed on 27 April 1521.
hist-exp-02-c3.claim: reached the Philippines, where Magellan was killed in a skirmish in April 1521.
